_about: The surface parking lot by the Main Entrance (decisions/0026), drawn as a landmark: asphalt, painted stalls, parked cars facing the drive aisles, and a parking sign by the entrance. Car cells use the solid 'c' tile; the aisles and empty stalls stay walkable.
name: Parking Lot
sources: Drawn from the official campus map's Parking Area A (research/Rose-Hill-Campus-Map.pdf); no photo used
